findings.title: Patient family name and MRN written to the application log
findings.recommendation: Remove the log line. PatientService.create already calls audit.record(Action.CREATE, "Patient", saved.getId()), which logs the id only. Add a test that captures the AUDIT and root loggers and asserts no MRN appears.

checkedClean.evidence: The diff adds no @Query, native query or string-built JPQL; PatientRepository keeps derived queries only.

limitations: Diff-only review: files outside the diff were read only where the changed code calls them.
